stories.title: Airbus plans to reroute river at Broughton to make way for “major facility”
stories.summary: Airbus wants to reroute a stretch of river beside its Broughton factory to make way for a major facility it is planning on the land. stories.title: Two arrested in Flintshire overnight over suspected cooking oil theft
stories.summary: Two people were arrested in south Flintshire overnight on suspicion of stealing cooking oil, police have said. Officers were called out 40 times overnight, according to an update from North Wales Police’s South Flintshire team. stories.title: DVSA told to stop using A494 Aston Hill lorry check spot after no approval record found
stories.summary: DVSA officers were told to stop using a roadside spot on the A494 at Aston Hill to wait for lorries, after the Welsh Government said it could find no record that they had ever been allowed to. stories.title: Welsh Government urged to keep free milk for 80,000 primary school children after Senedd vote
stories.summary: Ministers are under pressure to keep free school milk for 80,000 primary school children in Wales, after Senedd Members backed a call to rule out axing the scheme.
